geometry_notes: All outline dimensions are tabulated in BD-652M; D = sum of the depth-data columns and half-widths close exactly for every row.
Convention: the 3/4 x 3/4 in chamfers of BD-652M note 5 are omitted, as in PennDOT's own tabulated properties (sharp outlines reproduce printed A/yb/I to print precision).
Box void: 5 in webs, 3 in top slab, 5 1/2 in bottom slab, 45-degree void corner fillets 1 1/2 x 1 1/2 in for depth <= 21 in and 3 x 3 in otherwise (BD-652M sheet 1).

Adjacent boxes and planks: interior unit with the BC-775M shear-key recess on both faces: 3/8 in recess from the top down to 3 in (12 in planks) or 6 in (other depths), 3/8 in-rise taper to a 3/4 in recess, 3/4 in-rise taper back to the full face at 3+4 = 7 in (planks) or 6+6 = 12 in (boxes) below the top. BC-775M labels the 3 in/4 in pair 'FOR 12" BEAM DEPTHS'.

PINNED: BD-652M adjacent-box properties for depths 17-30 in match the 3 in/4 in (plank) key rather than the 6 in/6 in key BC-775M specifies for these depths; the implementation follows BC-775M, leaving ~1% area residuals for 17-30 in.

2008 edition row 24/63 printed dimensions (T2=9, C=29) but properties (872 in2, yb 29.71) of T2=6, C=32; the 2016 edition corrects the properties to 920 in2 / 30.90 in, consistent with the printed dimensions. The 2016 values are used.
